    if len(str(my_list)) == 13:

    while gap > 0:
        for i in range(gap, len(my_list)):
            current_item = my_list[i]

def max_product(arr):   
  n = len(arr)
  mpis = arr[:]
  for i in range(n): 
    current_prod = arr[i]
    j = i + 1
    while j < n:
      if arr[j-1] > arr[j]: 
        break
      current_prod *= arr[j]
      if current_prod > mpis[j]:
        mpis[j] = current_prod 
      j = j + 1
  return max(mpis)
